assets.prompt: Create a polished original environment concept for SOULMONSTERS, a contemporary monster-collection adventure set in the lively present-day Rua dos Ventos neighborhood of Kronasta. One large wide landscape image, high-angle three-quarter axonometric overview with clear street layout and convincing architectural depth. Contemporary anime 2D production design: crisp confident ink outlines, vivid LOCAL FLAT COLORS, a single clear hard-edged cel shadow per material, simple broad ground masses and simplified tree foliage. Precise readable shapes, no texture noise, no painterly grain, no 3D render, no medieval or rustic architecture, no exposed bamboo huts, no straw roofs, no dirt streets, no pastel toy town, no reused franchise logos. Present-day ordinary technology with a small amount of original speculative Soulmonster research tech, NOT cyberpunk or science-fiction megacity. The neighborhood feels warm, used and inhabited. Build a coherent ORIGINAL SMALL TOWN QUARTER of 3 asphalt streets connected around an open pocket plaza, eight buildings on separate plots with breathing room and small gardens, wide raised sidewalks with real curb depth, storm drains, crosswalks, street trees in selected groups, bus shelter, two parked compact cars and a delivery scooter. Distinct destinations: foreground left KAEL'S HOUSE, a compact TWO-STORY white warm-ivory home, deep cobalt blue recessed upper wall, one bold thin CORAL RED roof-edge band, offset flat roof volumes, a long horizontal bedroom window, a small projecting balcony with blue perforated metal railing, shaded entry porch, a little walled garden and blue mailbox. Upper right PROFESSOR ASSIS'S LAB, low one-story asymmetrical building in WHITE and TEAL with orange entry inset, two broad shallow curved roof shells that meet beside a tall central rectangular clerestory. A wind-measuring silver arc and compact weather mast stand on the lab roof, glass foyer, a small outdoor testing courtyard. Foreground right NEIGHBORHOOD SOULMONSTER SHOP, a one-story L-shaped coral and cream shop with a broad rounded cobalt canopy, blue glass display windows, a compact diamond-loop white sign on the canopy and bright product display inside. Three to five different background homes with warm yellow, mint and lilac accents, different sizes and roof outlines, one duplex, one house with roof garden. TWO TERRAIN LEVELS gently stepping up from foreground residential street to lab court, use one clearly continuous sloped asphalt street and a broad pedestrian stair with intermediate landing cutting through the retaining wall, connected open upper and lower landings. All houses touch their lots, no floating objects. Strong wayfinding by lab silhouette, open plaza and shop canopy. A shallow planted rain garden beside plaza, no water hazards. 7 tiny adults and children doing different everyday activities for scale, not character portraits. Tech objects include a small charging dock for delivery scooter, a public route display and a few roof solar panels. Soulmonsters' identity emerges in a few subtle taut diagonal canopy supports and diamond-loop device shapes, no oversized kite-shaped houses and no decorative diamonds scattered across floors. Restrained prop density, open walkable pavement and varied setbacks. Daylight, quiet blue hard shadows, fresh warm bright optimistic atmosphere, clean hand-drawn anime game art. Entire neighborhood fills the canvas, no isolated floating island base, no UI, no text labels, no title, no collage.
